_comment: llm-rule-engine policy for the hrrr-ingest take-home. R3 (1 ms latency budget) does not apply to a network-bound batch CLI; R11 (threat model) has no auth or credential surface to protect because HRRR is a public, unsigned S3 bucket.

R9._comment: mutmut 2.x is installed, so mutation evidence is required. Every surviving mutant needs the owner's own approval ('approve mutants <ids>'), case by case.

packages._comment: Adding any package not listed here blocks until the user approves it.

verifiers._comment: on_missing=block so a missing scanner (osv-scanner for uv.lock) fails loudly instead of silently waiving R7.
